prompts.single:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit image 1, the existing rhythm-game sprite. Image 2 is an exact geometry guide, not a desired presentation. Output only the sprite.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: edit the LOWER horizontal seam at y=47, NOT the white light bar at y=28. Previous attempts only changed the cap of that white bar, which is WRONG. The guide's white dots show the required vertices, and its pink paths show the actual final edge directions, not decorative marks.
Coordinates are on the 400x80 input sprite:
LEFT: the thin horizontal seam runs from (75,47) to a common vertex (99,47). At that SAME VERTEX it must visibly fork into an UP-RIGHT edge ending at (111,36), and a DOWN-RIGHT edge continuing to (113,77). The top branch is currently missing. Create this unmistakable three-armed "-<" junction at the lower seam. The up-right edge crosses the slanted rim to meet the raised central panel, forming a small side face that shows the difference in height.
RIGHT: mirror exactly: horizontal seam (325,47) to (301,47), UP-LEFT branch to (289,36), DOWN-LEFT branch to (287,77).
Use distinct crisp metal edges and a small shaded planar side face so BOTH diagonal branches can actually be seen. Make the new rising branch at least as legible as the existing downward edge. Do not merely make a parallel bevel or color gradient: the contour really FORKS at the lower horizontal seam. Rework the old unbroken slanted seam locally as needed so the join reads as a clear step.
The top white bars and their ends at y=28 MUST stay unchanged. Keep all pixels outside the two lower joins as close as possible to original. Maintain the calm flat stylized material, colors, outer rectangle, widths, chevron icons and lower glowing rim hotspots. No new broad glow, no large 3D bulge, no pink lines, white guide dots, text, diagrams or margins in the result.
Return the full original 5:1 sprite strip, unchanged framing and transparency.
Blue single sprite: keep one triple-chevron icon and one central bottom glow. Keep the existing BLUE color; gold in the guide is reference only.
